key_policy: Choice key = natural 1-5 word English name of the label, fixed for every split, variant and model (DESIGN field rule 2, D8). Descriptions (D_*) and propositions (P_*) are authored separately per pool and never live in this file.
label_id_type: predicate and scale ids defined here (the source has no label ids for them)

labels.note: the target string is slotted into the question, not the key

labels.construct: sentiment of the tweet toward the named target
labels.rule: R0 BASE_SRC; polarity reversal R7 allowed
labels.source_field: gold_label (0-4, SemEval-2016 Task 4C: strongly negative .. strongly positive)
